remarks: Beautifully updated and full of charm, this surprisingly spacious townhome offers the ease of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most convenient locations. The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated, while beautiful hardwood floors shine throughout, abundant natural light fills the home, and 7 inch crown moldings bring warmth and character. The grand primary suite is a true retreat with an oversized bathroom, a massive walk-in closet, and two additional closets for effortless organization. The finished lower level is a standout feature, offering wonderful flex space for a family room plus a home office and workout space. Outside, enjoy a private fenced in backyard with a charming slate patio where the peaceful sounds of the nearby river create a relaxing backdrop. There is excellent storage throughout in addition to a vaulted attic with full flooring for even more room, and a one car attached garage. All of this in a low-maintenance setting just moments from town, shops, restaurants, and the train, with the rare benefit of no HOA dues. A special opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and easy living in the heart of New Canaan.
